text: Free CI: clean install and pnpm check on every push (GitHub Actions)
description: No CI exists; the first-run test failure fixed in 0ee4507 went unnoticed until a manual clean clone. GitHub Actions is free for public repositories on standard runners, so this costs nothing while the repo stays public. Workflow: checkout, pnpm install (cache the pnpm store and the embedding model), pnpm check. Keep it to one job; no deploys, no secrets.

status.comment:
Workflow committed (not pushed, so not yet run on GitHub). Needs a push and a first green run to be confirmed.

.github/workflows/check.yml: checkout, pnpm/action-setup (packageManager pnpm 11.3.0), Node 22 with pnpm store cache, install --frozen-lockfile, embedding model cache (actions/cache on the transformers .cache glob), pnpm check, pnpm validate:bowman ., pnpm build, bundled loop-worker load smoke test; 30 min limit, no secrets.

Simulated in a fresh clone of HEAD: install ok, validate ok (791 ideas valid), build ok, bundle smoke ok; pnpm check FAILED on the cold model cache: backend globalSetup and agent-tools code-intelligence downloaded the model concurrently into one cache -> aborted fetch after 132 s, backend search/loop tests timed out. Fixes: pnpm check runs backend warm:model once before the model-using suites (1e886ac) and stops a stalled download after 10 min with a clear message (this commit). Cold verification of the fix could not complete today: huggingface.co stalled the 130 MB model at 20 MB (curl confirmed small files fine, large stalled). Warm path verified locally (pnpm check 25/25). Note: actions/cache only saves after a successful job, so the first CI run must download the model.
